content: Python is a high-level interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability. It was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. Python supports multiple programming paradigms including procedural object-oriented and functional programming. Python is widely used in web development data science artificial intelligence machine learning automation and scripting. Popular Python frameworks include Django and FastAPI for web development NumPy and Pandas for data analysis and TensorFlow and PyTorch for machine learning. Python uses indentation to define code blocks instead of curly braces. Variables in Python are dynamically typed meaning you do not need to declare their type explicitly. Python has a large standard library and a massive ecosystem of third-party packages available through pip. Python lists are ordered and mutable collections that can hold items of different types. Dictionaries in Python store key-value pairs and are optimized for fast lookups. Python functions are defined using the def keyword and can return multiple values using tuples. Python classes support inheritance encapsulation and polymorphism. Exception handling in Python uses try except finally blocks. Python generators use the yield keyword to produce values lazily without storing them all in memory.
